install: test -s geo/GeoLite2-City.mmdb || npx --yes corepack pnpm@12.3.4 run build:geo

db.cmd:
printf 'services:
  db:
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
' | docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f - up --no-deps db

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec -T db pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U umami -d umami -q; do sleep 1; done' && npx --yes corepack pnpm@12.3.4 run check:db && exec env -u AI_AGENT npx --yes corepack pnpm@12.3.4 run dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" < /dev/null
